g.text: Full-horizon coverage includes zero-force flight; contact-only coverage is shown when recorded. Sensor-noise uncertainty is separate.
Coefficient coverage in run records targets the declared field projection. Retained simulated-forecast limit overruns: 0/864 records.
Finite MC (16 members): Gaussian-reference coverage 80.66%; a diagnostic, not a FEM coverage correction. Analytic coefficient intervals are unaffected.
